question: Gaganyaan is planned to orbit Earth at approximately what altitude?
solution:
The correct answer is __**400 km**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission** is India's first human spaceflight program developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• The planned altitude for the orbit of the spacecraft is approximately **400 km** from Earth's surface.
 
• At this altitude, the spacecraft will perform microgravity experiments and other scientific studies.
 
• The mission aims to send a crew of three astronauts into space for a duration of up to **seven days**.
 
• The spacecraft will orbit in a low Earth orbit (LEO), which is ideal for human spaceflight missions due to reduced radiation exposure compared to higher altitudes.
 
• This milestone mission is expected to establish India as the fourth nation to send humans into space, after the USA, Russia, and China.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Gaganyaan mission is part of India's efforts to advance its space exploration capabilities and develop the technological infrastructure for human spaceflight.
 
• It involves critical systems like the **GSLV Mk III rocket** (launch vehicle), crew module, environmental control and life support systems, and ground support systems.
 
• Through Gaganyaan, ISRO aims to enhance India's status as a spacefaring nation and open avenues for future interplanetary missions.
